exact_added_capabilities: os.symlink/posix.symlink only new fixture destination and target lexically inside the same owned fixture root; ordinary ancestors, no symlink target; no dir_fd
os.mkfifo/posix.mkfifo only mode0600 fixture nodes, no dir_fd; no FIFO read/open admitted
os.unlink/os.remove/posix aliases for fixture leaf removal only; no root removal or dir_fd
os.rmdir/posix.rmdir only fixture descendants, ordinary parents, no root/dir_fd

os.fdopen only rb for one registered ordinary read-only descriptor opened under fixtures or selected packet with exact O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK flags; fstat identity verified; authority consumed immediately
os.close only a still-registered descriptor, to clean up a refused fdopen; unregistered host descriptors refused
unchanged_denials: process creation/discovery/waits/signals including all old named APIs
descriptor writes, dup, pipes, pty, arbitrary FileIO, fd-based builtins/io.open
inherited_read_boundary: Existing ordinary Python pathname reads remain inherited from the known-source guard; no claim of an adversarial sandbox. Newly admitted descriptors are confined to owned fixtures and the selected packet.

fixture_lifecycle.requirement: Fresh absolute canonical-parent path, basename pair7-java-controls-*, separate from packet, created once by launcher before guard install
fixture_lifecycle.final_disposition: Retain explicit root for review. No external cleanup or host resource operation.

refusal_controls: write-mode fdopen of owned read-only descriptor
unexpected_guard_denials: Fail the selected control run. Guard rejections never count as subject-test passes.
